battle.name: 帕達里戰爭
battle.theater: 恩特雷里奧斯省帕達里戰場
battle.brief: 一八二一年三月，普林格利斯接掌拉普拉塔河口聯合省的遠征軍，沿巴拉那河北上進攻聯邦同盟；四月五日於恩特雷里奧斯帕達里一役，中央軍攻陣失利，火砲與輜重盡失，騎兵在河岸濕地被聯邦砲兵與地方騎兵擊潰。卡面輪發手槍是已退役的軍官隨身武器，真正決定交火的是燧發滑膛步槍與野戰砲。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 交戰的一方是以布宜諾斯艾利斯為首都的『拉普拉塔河口聯合省』中央政府。一八二一年初，該政府的軍權連番易手：最高指揮官隆多在一月任命的中央執委會下台，二月初塞佩達一役敗於聯邦軍，貝爾格拉諾接掌軍隊又迅速更替，三月由普林格利斯實際統兵。中央軍的骨幹是從歐洲戰爭體系轉入的線列步兵團、騎兵團與炮兵旅，步兵用西班牙系統的燧發滑膛步槍配筒形刺刀，炮兵是青銅滑膛野戰砲，輔以布宜諾斯艾利斯市民民兵與各省應徵的民兵；後方靠港口關稅收入與倫敦借款維持，糧秣與彈藥沿巴拉那河航道由船隊前運。另一方是『聯邦同盟』：科連特斯與恩特雷里奧斯兩省拒絕承認中央政府的關稅與主權，聖菲的洛佩斯在同年內加入，烏拉圭一帶的東方省也有聯邦派游擊隊在活動。聯邦軍以省屬騎兵、地方民兵與高卓游擊隊為主，配各省炮兵與一隊在河上攔截商船的武裝船隊，實力勝在騎兵、熟悉地形與握有航路。同一時期聯合省還要在上秘魯對抗蘇克雷的軍隊，兩條戰線同時拉開，中央軍的兵力、彈藥與時間都被分薄。
countriesEn: One side was the central government of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, based in Buenos Aires. In the opening months of 1821 the command of that government changed hands repeatedly: the Supreme Director Rondeau was pushed out under the executive committee appointed in January, the army lost the Battle of Cepeda to the federal forces in early February, Belgrano took over the troops and was himself replaced in short order, and in March Pringles actually held the field command. The backbone of the central army was made up of line infantry regiments, cavalry and artillery brigades carried over from the European war system: the infantry carried Spanish pattern flintlock muskets with socket bayonets, the artillery bronze smoothbore field guns, with the citizen militia of Buenos Aires and the levies of the provinces attached to them. Rearward, the government lived on port customs revenue and a loan raised in London, and grain, ammunition and powder moved forward by river boat along the Paraná. The other side was the Federal League: the provinces of Corrientes and Entre Ríos refused to acknowledge the central government's customs monopoly and sovereignty, Santa Fe under López joined within the same year, and federal partisans were active in the Oriental Province around Uruguay. The federal army was built on provincial cavalry, local militia and gaucho bands, supported by the provincial artillery and a fleet of armed boats that intercepted merchant shipping on the river; its strength lay in horse, in local knowledge of the ground and in command of the navigation. At the same time the United Provinces had to face Sucre's army in Upper Peru, so two fronts were open at once and the central army's men, powder and time were all spread thin.
people: 雙方的關鍵人物在後來的歷史裡都留有清楚的位置。中央一方最關鍵的是普林格利斯：他生於蘇格蘭斯特靈，父親是隨軍移居聖菲的蘇格蘭人，他在邊境戰爭中由下級軍官升到指揮官，一八二一年三月接掌中央軍後把主動權推向聯邦省；四月五日帕達里失利，他仍北上上秘魯，同年十月在比爾卡普西奧、十二月在阿亞庫喬連敗於蘇克雷，獨立戰爭的北線至此崩解；其後他當上布宜諾斯艾利斯省督，一八二九年病逝。隆多在塞佩達敗後失勢流亡，貝爾格拉諾接掌軍隊不久亦交出指揮權。聯邦派方面，恩特雷里奧斯的省督兼將領塔拉戈納在帕達里主持陣地作戰；聖菲的洛佩斯由高卓軍官升任省督，六月二十八日在卡納達德拉克魯斯擊敗普林格利斯，迫使中央軍退出內陸；聯邦主義的旗手阿蒂加斯一八二○年後流亡巴拉圭，仍是這聯盟的精神核心。布宜諾斯艾利斯方面，日後成為聯邦派領袖的多雷戈在戰爭期間主持軍政，二二年當選省督；英國商人與外交官則在倫敦借款、槍械買賣與停戰斡旋之間穿梭，是這場內戰裡另一種關鍵角色。
peopleEn: The decisive figures on both sides kept clear places in the history that followed. On the central side the key man was Pringles. Born in Stirling in Scotland, the son of a Scotsman settled at Santa Fe, he rose from junior officer to commander in the frontier wars, and when he took the field command in March 1821 he drove the initiative towards the federal provinces. After the defeat at Padari on 5 April he went north to Upper Peru regardless, and in October of the same year was beaten at Vilcapugio and in December at Ayacucho by Sucre, which collapsed the northern front of the war of independence. He later became governor of Buenos Aires and died in 1829. Rondeau was swept away into exile after Cepeda, and Belgrano handed over command shortly after taking it. On the federal side the governor and commander of Entre Ríos, Tarragona, directed the fighting at Padari; López of Santa Fe rose from gaucho officer to governor and beat Pringles at Cañada de la Cruz on 28 June, forcing the central army back out of the interior; the standard-bearer of federalism, Artigas, was in exile in Paraguay after 1820 and remained the spiritual core of the league. On the Buenos Aires side Dorrego, who would later become a federal leader, ran the war administration and was elected governor in 1822; British merchants and diplomats moved between the London loan, the arms trade and attempts to mediate a peace, and were a different kind of key actor in this civil war.
kits: 卡面這件輪發手槍是十五世紀末西班牙的後膛手槍，靠發條驅動鋼輪摩擦輪緣的燧石（黃鐵礦）點燃藥盤，機構精密而零件繁多。它在一八二一年的拉普拉塔河兩岸早已不是制式武器：燧發手槍便宜、可靠、可以單手壓裝，輪發手槍卻要重新上弦、裝填緩慢、受潮容易卡死，造價更是普通手槍的數倍。它殘留的位置主要在軍官、炮兵護衛與地方總督的手上，屬於身分與價值的標誌，也是夜色或濕地裡不必點火繩便能立刻擊發的備用手段。真正決定帕達里交火的是別的兵器：中央軍步兵是西班牙式燧發滑膛步槍（口徑約六一五），配筒形刺刀與紙包定裝藥；騎兵用彎刀與帶刃長矛，軍官佩燧發手槍；炮兵是青銅滑膛四磅、六磅與十二磅野戰砲，另有少量榴彈砲。聯邦派一方的鄉民騎兵同樣靠彎刀、長矛、火繩槍與鄉土獵槍，也從省軍與私商手上買到燧發槍，馬鞍上照例掛一支手槍，用於營地守夜與單挑。彈藥供應兩邊都吃緊：中央軍靠布港進口火藥鉛料再沿河船運，聯邦派靠地方商號、走私與繳獲；帕達里一役中央軍丟掉的火砲與輜重，事後成了聯邦軍最直接的打擊手段補充。
kitsEn: The wheellock pistol on the card face was a Spanish breech-loading pistol of the late fifteenth century: a mainspring drives a steel wheel whose rim scrapes a pyrite against the frizzen to throw sparks into the priming pan, a mechanism both precise and made of many small parts. By 1821 it was no longer a service weapon on either bank of the Río de la Plata. Flintlock pistols were cheap, reliable and could be worked one-handed, while a wheellock had to be rewound, loaded slowly, jammed easily in damp, and cost several times as much as an ordinary pistol. What survived of it sat with officers, artillery guards and provincial governors, where it was a badge of rank and value and also a backup that could be fired in the dark or in wet ground without a burning match. The weapons that actually decided the shooting at Padari were others: the central infantry carried Spanish pattern flintlock muskets of about .615 calibre with socket bayonets and paper cartridges; the cavalry used sabres and barbed lances, officers carried flintlock pistols; the artillery brought bronze smoothbore guns of four, six and twelve pounds, with a few howitzers. The federal country horsemen fought with sabres, spears, matchlocks and country hunting guns as well, and bought flintlocks from provincial depots and private dealers; a pistol hung at the saddle as usual, for watching the camp and for single combat. Ammunition was tight on both sides: the central army imported powder and lead through the port of Buenos Aires and moved it by river boat, the federal side relied on local firms, smuggling and capture; and the guns and baggage the central army lost at Padari became the federal army's most direct replenishment of guns, powder and stores.
tactics: 中央軍照搬歐洲戰爭的線列與縱隊戰術：步兵結線齊射，刺刀牆壓住對方，炮兵展開在中央射擊，騎兵擔任衝鋒與追擊；靠船隊沿巴拉那河推進，靠沿岸據點與稅務站控制鄉村，試圖用速戰速決逼迫聯邦省屈服。帕達里一役暴露的弱點是：中央軍把騎兵大量集結在寬闊的河岸平原上，隊形一旦被砲火與地形切斷就難以重整；步兵的刺刀牆面對不發炮也不結陣的鄉民騎兵幾乎無從施展；而推進軸線只有一條，後方一旦被切斷，全軍便沒有第二個方向可退。聯邦派打的是地方戰：憑藉沼澤、柳林與島嶼地形，砲兵集中在陣前封鎖通道，騎兵在步兵兩翼反覆衝擊並追擊潰退者，用省騎兵加游擊隊的辦法把遠征軍拖成消耗戰；同時握有航路，用船隊封鎖與攔截中央軍的糧秣船，甚至讓對方無法補充火藥。聯邦派同樣避免正面進攻中央軍的密集步兵，除非對方已被消耗、脫離陣形或被河水與道路所限——帕達里正是這樣的殘局。中央軍在卡納達德拉克魯斯再敗之後退回布宜諾斯艾利斯，一八二二年一月才以四方條約換得喘息。
tacticsEn: The central army imported the linear and column tactics of the European wars: infantry closed into line and fired by volley, the bayonet wall pressed the enemy, artillery deployed in the centre to shoot, cavalry charged and pursued. It advanced along the Paraná with its boats, held the riverside posts and custom stations to control the countryside, and tried to force the federal provinces to yield quickly. The defeat at Padari exposed the weakness of the method: the central army massed its cavalry on the open floodplain of the river, and once a formation was cut by gunfire and by the ground it could hardly be reformed; the bayonet wall of the infantry had little to work against country horsemen who neither stood to fire nor formed up; and there was only one axis of advance, so once the rear was cut the whole army had nowhere else to go. The federal side fought a local war: it used marsh, willow scrub and river islands, concentrated its guns in front to seal the approaches, hammered the flanks of the infantry with repeated cavalry charges and pursued the broken, and turned an expedition into a war of attrition with provincial horse and partisan bands. At the same time it held the navigation, sending armed boats to blockade and intercept the army's supply craft and even cutting off powder resupply. The federal side likewise avoided frontal attacks on the dense central infantry unless their opponent was exhausted, out of formation, or hemmed in by river and road, and Padari was exactly such a situation. After the second defeat at Cañada de la Cruz the central army withdrew to Buenos Aires and did not draw breath again until the Quadrilateral Treaty of January 1822.
data: 可核對的日期集中在幾個節點上：一八二一年二月一日塞佩達一役，中央軍首次敗於聯邦軍；三月普林格利斯接掌遠征軍並沿巴拉那河北上；四月五日帕達里開火；同年六月二十八日在卡納達德拉克魯斯再敗，前線的遠征計畫至此作廢；一八二二年一月二十五日布宜諾斯艾利斯與三個聯邦省簽訂四方條約，戰線才凍結下來。兵力方面，帕達里的中央軍以騎兵為主，各書多記為一、兩千騎為主力的部隊加少量步兵；聯邦軍人數略少，但砲兵更多、陣位更佳，聯邦軍在陣前集中了數門野戰砲，這是雙方記載中唯一大致一致的一點。傷亡與被俘數字各書相差極遠，統計多出自雙方各自的軍報，難以核對，因此只能說雙方都在數百人量級。距離上，遠征軍自布宜諾斯艾利斯到前線要沿河口與巴拉那河行軍數百公里，糧秣全靠船運；同一年中央軍還在上秘魯同時作戰，兵員、火藥與時間的調度更顯緊張。
dataEn: The checkable dates cluster around a few nodes: 1 February 1821, the Battle of Cepeda, where the central army was first beaten by the federal forces; March, when Pringles took command of the expedition and moved north along the Paraná; 5 April, the firing at Padari; 28 June of the same year, the second defeat at Cañada de la Cruz, after which the expeditionary plan was dead; and 25 January 1822, when Buenos Aires and the three federal provinces signed the Treaty of the Quadrilateral and the front froze. On numbers: at Padari the central army was mainly cavalry, the accounts usually giving a force whose core was one or two thousand horsemen with a small infantry element; the federal army was slightly smaller in men but had more guns and better positions, concentrating several field pieces in front of its line, and that is the one point on which the two sets of records roughly agree. Casualty and prisoner figures differ wildly, most of them coming from the parties' own reports and hard to verify, so the most that can be said is that losses ran into the hundreds on both sides. On distance: the expedition had to march several hundred kilometres from Buenos Aires to the front along the estuary and the Paraná, with all food moving by boat; in the same year the central army was fighting in Upper Peru as well, which made the allocation of men, powder and time even tighter.
cause: 中央軍之所以再度北上，源於一八二○年之後聯邦省對中央權力的抵抗。一八二○年塞佩達河畔一役，聯邦派聯軍打垮布宜諾斯艾利斯省政府，迫使中央政府改組，之後聖菲、恩特雷里奧斯與科連特斯各自選督、拒絕承認聯合省的關稅專賣與軍隊駐紮；烏拉圭一帶的東方省也捲入中央軍、聯邦派與葡萄牙-巴西佔領軍的三方角力。阿蒂加斯主張的聯邦主義——各省自決、聯邦協商而非中央統一——在拉普拉塔河兩岸得到共鳴。中央政府則認為邊疆各省欠繳的海關紅利與外來移民造成的秩序崩壞必須用兵一次解決，布宜諾斯艾利斯還想藉此打通巴拉那河航路，把各省的經濟收入收回中央。直接導火線是一八二一年初中央軍沿江推進、接管關卡與據點，聯邦省的省督拒絕交出稅站，兩軍在帕達里正面相遇。國際層面同樣在推波：英國商人向聯邦派與中央派同時販售槍械，倫敦金融界擔心中央政府崩潰會危及英資與英國貿易，巴西與葡萄牙在東方省步步進逼，而聯合省自己還在上秘魯與蘇克雷的軍隊纏鬥，遠征兵力因此被抽薄。
causeEn: The central army went north again because of the resistance of the federal provinces after 1820. The battle by the Cepeda stream in 1820 broke the provincial government of Buenos Aires and forced a reconstruction of the central authority, and after that Santa Fe, Entre Ríos and Corrientes each chose their own governors and refused to acknowledge the United Provinces' customs monopoly or the quartering of troops; the Oriental Province around Uruguay was drawn into a three-cornered struggle between the central army, the federal partisans and the Portuguese-Brazilian occupation. The federalism argued by Artigas, that provinces should decide for themselves and associate in a league rather than be ruled from the centre, found its audience on both banks of the Río de la Plata. The central government argued instead that the unpaid customs dividends of the frontier provinces and the disorder caused by incoming settlers had to be settled once and for all by arms, and Buenos Aires also wanted to open the navigation of the Paraná and pull the provinces' economic revenue back to the centre. The immediate spark was the central army's advance along the river in early 1821, taking over custom houses and posts; the provincial governors refused to hand over the tax stations and the two armies met in earnest at Padari. The international setting pushed the same way: British merchants sold arms to federal and central sides alike, the London money market feared that a collapse of the central government would endanger British capital and British trade, Brazil and Portugal pressed forward in the Oriental Province, and the United Provinces itself was locked in combat with Sucre's army in Upper Peru, so the expedition was thinned out before it began.
impact: 帕達里的失敗改變了拉普拉塔河流域的權力格局：中央政府再沒有一八二一年那樣的兵力去壓服內陸省份，聯邦各省的自治成為既成事實，隨後的四方條約把省際關係改以條約式聯盟處理，成為一八三一年聯邦公約的先聲；布宜諾斯艾利斯也放棄用兵統一，把注意力轉向巴塔哥尼亞與首都自身。軍事上，這場戰爭提供了教科書式的反面教材：以歐洲線列與密集步兵為骨幹的遠征軍，在熟悉地形的省屬騎兵、集中在陣前的砲兵與握有航路的對手面前消耗殆盡；後來拉普拉塔河內陸的幾次會戰——一八二九至一八三一年的拉瓦列與基羅加內戰——幾乎都沿用聯邦派的路線，也讓高卓騎兵與地方炮兵成為國家武力的主幹。經濟上，巴拉那河航權與沿江關稅歸誰掌握的問題被推遲而未解，海關紅利之爭從一八二○年代拖到一八三○年代，最終成為聯邦各省市政分化與彼此角力的核心籌碼。文化上，這一役在阿根廷內戰記憶中位於中央單一國家對聯邦省份這個命題的起點，後世的政治論戰不斷回引它。
impactEn: The defeat at Padari changed the balance of power in the Río de la Plata region. The central government never again had the forces to crush the inland provinces by war, the autonomy of the federal provinces became a fait accompli, and the Treaty of the Quadrilateral that followed turned relations between provinces into a league kept alive by treaties, anticipating the Federal Pact of 1831; Buenos Aires also gave up trying to unify by arms and turned its attention to Patagonia and to the capital's own affairs. Militarily, the war stands as a textbook reverse lesson: an expeditionary army built on the European line and on dense infantry was worn down by provincial cavalry that knew the ground, by guns massed in front of the position, and by an enemy who held the navigation; the later civil battles in the interior of the Río de la Plata, the Lavalle-Quiroga wars of 1829 to 1831, followed the federal line of thought almost throughout, and gaucho horse and provincial artillery became the trunk of the country's armed force. Economically, the question of who would hold the navigation of the Paraná and the customs posts along it was only deferred, not answered: the fight over the customs dividends ran from the 1820s into the 1830s and became the central stake in the political fragmentation of the federal provinces and in their quarrels with one another. Culturally, this battle sits in Argentine civil war memory at the starting point of the proposition of a single central state against the federal provinces, and later political argument has gone on quoting it ever since.
result: 就帕達里一役本身而言，結果是清楚的失敗：普林格利斯以中央軍主力的攻陣被聯邦軍在陣前砲火與反衝擊中打破，火砲與輜重盡失，殘部退向河口方向，遠征計畫實際上已經終止；同年六月二十八日他又在卡納達德拉克魯斯敗於洛佩斯與聖菲軍，十二月上秘魯方向也傳來比爾卡普西奧與阿亞庫喬兩場慘敗，中央政府的北進南征在同一年裡全面崩盤。聯邦派贏得了戰役，卻沒有因此統一全國：一八二二年一月的四方條約只是把停火固定下來，中央政府換上和平內閣、軍隊縮編，通過一八二三年新憲法，並一度在帕斯將軍與拉瓦列手中把內陸各省拉回中央聯盟；但一八二九年之後的內戰又把這一切打散，聯邦各省重新分立。從武器史的角度看，這場戰爭是舊式軍官手槍的時代註腳：輪發手槍這類昂貴的後膛手槍退居軍官佩飾，真正在原野上分出勝負的，是燧發滑膛步槍的射擊、刺刀牆的厚度、青銅砲的射程與數量，以及高卓騎兵在雨季泥濘中的機動與補給。
resultEn: Taken on its own, the result at Padari was an unambiguous defeat. Pringles' attack with the main body of the central army was broken by the federal guns massed in front of the position and by the counter-charge; the artillery and the baggage were lost and the broken remnant fell back towards the estuary, which in practice ended the expedition. On 28 June of the same year he was beaten again at Cañada de la Cruz by López and the Santa Fe forces, and in December came news of the disasters at Vilcapugio and Ayacucho from the Upper Peru front, so that the central government's war in the north and in the south came apart in a single year. The federal side won the battle but did not thereby unify the country: the Treaty of the Quadrilateral of January 1822 only fixed the truce in place, the central government changed to a peace ministry, cut the army, passed a new constitution in 1823 and for a while pulled the inland provinces back into a central league under General Paz and Lavalle; but the civil wars that followed 1829 broke all of that up again and the federal provinces fell apart once more. Seen from the history of weapons, this war is a footnote to the age of the officer's pistol: expensive breech-loading pistols such as the wheellock retired into the insignia of rank, and what decided the field was the shooting of the flintlock smoothbore musket, the thickness of the bayonet wall, the reach and number of the bronze guns, and the movement and supply of gaucho horse in the mud of the rainy season.
